verdict.rationale: The evidence shows human approval gates for Customer Agent tool actions, sent to Slack with approve/deny buttons, and default manual approval for Internal Agent configuration actions. Nothing documents a supervised or draft mode where customer-facing replies are held for human approval before sending. Tool-action gating and pre-launch simulations are adjacent controls, not the reply-approval capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I can launch in a supervised mode where the agent drafts replies for human approval before anything reaches a customer
